  - option: a long-lived local server the CLI talks to over a Unix socket

  - option: split into a thin CLI plus a background indexer process

One binary, no server process, no socket to own. The config file on disk is
the only per-repo state the CLI reads; no server process is required to run
it. Fixture entry for `internal/enforcer`, mirroring the real
`dec-0001`/`int-0002` pairing.
